mods.name: Timelined Mario Kart 8
mods.author: Boltthunder4
mods.description:
This Modpack contains:
-46 High Quality Custom Tracks & 2 Texture Hacks 
-Music for every Custom Track
-Custom Cup Icons and other UI Changes
-Lots of Sonic Universe Characters
-Custom Sonic themed Karts and Bikes
-Custom title screens with custom voice lines!
-Pretendo Network compatibility!
-An Exhilarating way to experience MK8u from a different Timeline!
